summary.text: Cindy Brake is the Democratic candidate for West Virginia State Senate District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Zack Maynard and independent Shawn Legg.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her priorities are lowering the cost of utilities, health care and child care, addressing addiction, and finding solutions for the unhoused population.

paragraphs.text: Cindy Brake advanced from the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary for District 7, defeating Michael Karr with 57.1 percent of the vote.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she moved to West Virginia because of its natural beauty and stays because of its people.
She said she wants to give all West Virginians a voice.
